verses.text: Listen to this! Yahweh’s power [MTY] is not ended/gone, with the result that he cannot save you.
But, you have separated yourselves from your God by the sins that you have committed.
You do violent things [MTY] to others,
When you accuse someone in court, what you say is not fair and it is not true.
What you plan to do to harm people [MET] is as dangerous as the eggs of a ◄cobra/poisonous snake►,
We people cannot hide/cover our skin with clothes made of spider webs [MET],
You [SYN] are very quick to go and do evil things,
You do not know how to act peacefully or to treat others fairly.
Because of that, God does not rescue us from our enemies;
We are like [SIM] blind people who have to feel along a wall to be able to walk anywhere.
We growl like [SIM] hungry bears;
But these things are happening because it is as though our sins are piled high in the presence of God,
We know that we have rebelled against Yahweh;
In our courts, the judges do not decide cases/matters fairly;
No one tells the truth,
He was disgusted when he saw that no one tried to help those who were being treated cruelly.
It is as though he is a soldier who [MET] puts on his armor and a helmet;
He will repay his enemies for the evil things that they have done.
When that happens, people everywhere, from the east to the west, will respect and honor Yahweh [MTY],
And Yahweh says that he will come to Jerusalem to free his people;
This is what Yahweh says to his people: “This is the agreement that I will make with you:
